description.text: 1. Introduction The aim of foundation course is to cultivate qualified candidates for undergraduate admission to SUFE. After one year’s time, both the Chinese proficiency and major knowledge of students could reach the level of the sophomores at SUFE. Students can enter the second year of our undergraduate course with all the credits if they successfully graduate from the foundation course

duration.text: The Foundation Program at Shanghai University of Finance and Economics is a 1 Year long program for international students, taught in Chinese.

fees.text: Application Fee: $ 305 USD Service Fee: $ 50 USD Tuition fee: $ 3611 USD/per year ￥ 26000 CNY/per year

materials.text: 1.Photocopy of valid passport With photo, passport number &expiration date and name included. 2.Passport-sized photo A passport-sized photo taken recently of the applicant. 3.Graducation Certificate of High school Graduation Certificate should be in English or Chinese, if not，it should be translated into English or Chinese and be notarized 4.Academic transcript of high school 5.HSK Certificate (No need for English-taught program)

requirements.text: 1. (Applicants should be between the) age of 18 to 45 2.High school graduate or equivalent or above. 3.New HSK Level 4 4..Be in good health and foreigners
